text_block_list.text: Huff! Wheeze! Guh!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
U-unbelievable! Did you see how fast
she was
going? Фудзи Кисэки's a force to be
reckoned with!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
Right?! She was so mesmerizing, I
couldn't take
my eyes off her!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
It's too bad she won't win the Triple
Crown... But
still, I'm excited to see her
run in the Japanese
Derby!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки's performance at the Satsuki
Sho has
set the crowd ablaze!

Thank you! Your support is what keeps
me going!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The dream is only just beginning! I hope
you're
looking forward to seeing me at
the Japanese
Derby!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: (I sure talked big back there, but...)
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Hm...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: The truth is, something's bothering me.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Would it be all right if I did some solo
training
tonight to check out a few
things?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
You say your legs felt strange after
completing
the Satsuki Sho, but it
doesn't seem to be an
injury, correct?
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
Right, it's nothing like that. But I feel
like I'm
being held back by some kind of
wall, and I
wanted to discuss it with you.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
A wall, huh? In other words... you want
to talk
about your distance aptitude,
yes?
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text: Exactly. I knew you'd get it!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I've felt this way for a while now, but I
think I'm
most suited to be a miler.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I'll be able to get accurate data
with your
assistance, so could you help
me, please?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I could... But the thing is,
whatever one
does, there must be an
equivalent exchange.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
How's this? If you help test out my new
medicine,
I'll lend you a hand in your
research.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text: Um... It's a deal! I'll take your medicine!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Good! Glad we're on the same page.
Now, let's
not waste any time getting
started.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
But first, a few words of warning—even if
you run
the same times в тренировке as
you do in a real
race, the stress on your
body will differ.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
Remember to take these test results with
a grain
of salt. Right, let's start you off
with a
2,400-meter run!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text: Huff! Huff! Wheeze!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
(This is the fourth corner—I have to burst
into a
final spurt!)
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Nghhh! Come ooon!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Oooh! Well, well, well! Gut instincts are
truly
nothing to sneeze at.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text: How was that?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
What fascinating results! Ah, but I
mustn't get
ahead of myself.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
Are you familiar with the terms "aerobic
energy"
and "anaerobic energy"?
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
Of course! We learned about them in
class.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, we use aerobic
energy to
maintain our cruising speed
during races...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
And we use anaerobic energy to
accelerate
quickly at the beginning and
end of a race. Did I
get that right?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
You certainly did! During races, our
bodies
generate these two types of
energy and consume
them as we run!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
They're both essential, but the way
anaerobic
energy is used is particularly
important.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
It's used during critical points in a race,
but
there's only so much of it. Deplete
it, and our legs
will stop working out of
sheer exhaustion.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
In other words, much hinges on your
ability to
preserve your anaerobic
energy until the final
turning point.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
At the same time, if your body is unable
to
maintain your running speed with
aerobic energy,
it will supplement your
muscles with anaerobic
energy.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text: Hm, so that would mean...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The faster your pace and the longer the
race, the
more your stores of anaerobic
energy will get
used up, right?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Roughly speaking, yes! Now, let's
examine your
run.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
After the 2,000-meter mark, your form
began to
deteriorate and you were
visibly struggling to
keep your pace.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
I suspect this is because you had
depleted your
stores of anaerobic
energy while trying to sustain
your
speed.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
Then, right before the end, when you
were just
about to reach the finish line
and were trying to
speed up...
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text: Nghhh! Come ooon!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
You were out of anaerobic energy and
lactic acid
had built up in your legs,
utterly exhausting you!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
Your strongest asset is your ability to
put on an
extra burst of speed in the
final stretch, but when
you tried to do
it... Well, you ran out of gas.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
Taking into consideration our findings,
my
conclusion is that long-distance runs
aren't your
forte.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
You are exceptionally good at
converting
anaerobic energy into bursts
of speed in
short-distance sprints...
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
However, your body's ability to
transport oxygen
to your muscles, which
affects the production of
aerobic
energy, appears to be only average.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
I see... Everything you're saying makes
sense.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much for your help. Now I can
finally
progress my training!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
No problem at all. And now, it's time for
my side
of the bargain! Time to take
your medicine!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
Is this actually safe to drink? The color is
really...
alarming.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat the small stuff! Bottoms up,
now!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
The next day, Фудзи Кисэки stops by my
office.

Yesterday, Tachyon helped me figure
out what
race lengths I'm best suited for.
Here's what we
discovered...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
She goes on to explain how participating
in
anything longer than a
medium-distance race will
drastically
decrease her chances of winning.

That's all to say that tackling the
Japanese Derby
and Kikuka Sho will be
more herculean tasks than
we
anticipated.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Now that I realize this, I wanted to talk
to you
about our plans for the future.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Winning the Japanese Derby and the
Kikuka Sho
will be difficult since Fuji
Kiseki isn't well suited
for those
distances. Thus, I can only assume...
choice_data_list:
Do you want to give up on getting the Triple
Crown?

text_block_list.text:
No, not at all! In fact, I want to do the
opposite!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I now have two dramatic paths to choose
between
precisely because of my
incompatibility with
long-distance races!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I can continue taking on the Triple
Crown tour,
which will now be all the
more interesting due to
how challenging
it will be...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Or I can change directions completely
and throw
everything I've got into
conquering the mile tour!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Sorry for springing this on you,
especially since
you've been helping me
train for the Triple Crown
tour all this
time.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: When I realized I was facing a wall I couldn't simply muscle through, I started thinking about what I could do instead.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Winning the Triple Crown is a huge
honor, and
there would be no greater
show I could put on
and have end in
victory.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to claim glory upon
that
enormous stage and give everyone
a truly
fulfilling sense of catharsis.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
But if I'm more suited toward mile races,
then that
changes things.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I could pursue a different path—I could
push my
sprinting ability to the max and
put on a fantastic
show on the mile tour!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I know this is sudden, but what do you
think I
should do? Which path should I
take?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Just which path should we choose? In
the end, I'm
unable to give her an
answer right away.
